SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)
FROM order_items
WHERE product_id IN (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM products
    WHERE category = 'beauty'
)
AND order_id IN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    AND status != 'cancelled'
    AND customer_id IN (
        SELECT customer_id
        FROM customers
        WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
        AND is_internal = FALSE
    )
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.placed_at < '2025-02-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = false

SELECT
  SUM(o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108 WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067 END) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at) = '2025-01-01'::DATE;

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(gross_revenue_usd - refunds_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(o.amount_minor * CASE 
      WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      ELSE 0
    END) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor * CASE 
      WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      ELSE 0
    END), 0) AS refunds_usd
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at) = '2025-01-01'::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) subquery

SELECT
  SUM(gross_revenue_usd - refunds_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END AS gross_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor) OVER (PARTITION BY r.order_id), 0) * CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END AS refunds_usd
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
    AND o.placed_at >= '2025-02-01'
    AND o.placed_at < '2025-03-01'
) aggregated
GROUP BY order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(net) FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) * CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END AS net
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
    AND o.placed_at >= '2025-02-01'
    AND o.placed_at < '2025-03-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.amount_minor, o.currency
)

SELECT
    SUM(gross_revenue_usd - refunds_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor * CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN o.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END AS gross_revenue_usd,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor) OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id), 0) * CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN o.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END AS refunds_usd
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND o.status != 'cancelled'
        AND c.is_internal = FALSE
        AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
        AND o.placed_at >= '2025-03-01'
        AND o.placed_at < '2025-04-01'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id) = 1
) subquery;

SELECT 
  SUM(order_revenue_usd) - SUM(refund_amount_usd) as net_revenue_usd
FROM (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END as order_revenue_usd
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at) = '2025-04-01'::TIMESTAMP
) orders_with_revenue
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    SUM(amount_minor) * 0.01 as refund_amount_usd
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) refunds_by_order ON orders_with_revenue.order_id = refunds_by_order.order_id;

SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS total_units_sold
FROM products p
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    AVG(net_revenue_usd) as average_order_value_usd
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        (o.amount_minor * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END - COALESCE(r.refund_amount_minor, 0) * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
            WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END) as net_revenue_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) as refund_amount_minor
        FROM refunds
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND c.is_internal = FALSE
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND o.status != 'cancelled'
        AND c.region = 'NA'
        AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
)

SELECT
  SUM(
    (oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor - COALESCE(refund_agg.total_refunds_minor * oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor / NULLIF(o.amount_minor, 0), 0)) *
    CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END
  ) AS revenue_usd
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total_refunds_minor
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) refund_agg ON o.order_id = refund_agg.order_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')

SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN (oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor - COALESCE(r.refund_total, 0)) * 0.0108
      WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN (oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor - COALESCE(r.refund_total, 0)) * 0.0067
    END
  ) as revenue_usd
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) as refund_total
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND p.category = 'electronics'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
  SUM(
    (oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor - COALESCE(r.total_refunds / oi_count.item_count, 0)) *
    CASE o.currency
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END
  ) as revenue_usd
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) as total_refunds
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as item_count
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
) oi_count ON o.order_id = oi_count.order_id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND p.category = 'home'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
  SUM(
    (oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor - COALESCE(refund_amounts.refund_per_item, 0)) *
    CASE
      WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
      WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
      WHEN o.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
    END
  ) AS revenue_usd
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) / COUNT(*) AS refund_per_item
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
) refund_amounts ON o.order_id = refund_amounts.order_id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND p.category = 'outdoors'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM refunds) THEN o.order_id END)::FLOAT / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS refund_share
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND p.category = 'apparel'

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM refunds) THEN o.order_id END)::FLOAT / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS refund_share
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND p.category = 'electronics'

WITH home_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND c.region = 'home'
),
orders_with_refunds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM refunds
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ho.order_id END)::FLOAT 
  / COUNT(DISTINCT ho.order_id) AS refund_share
FROM home_orders ho
LEFT JOIN orders_with_refunds r ON ho.order_id = r.order_id;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_refunds > 0 THEN order_id END)::FLOAT / 
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::FLOAT AS share_with_refund
FROM (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) AS total_refunds
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND p.category = 'outdoors'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) subquery

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM refunds) THEN 1 END)::FLOAT 
  / COUNT(*) AS share_with_refund
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'beauty'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE

WITH jan_2025_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at) = '2025-01-01'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_at) = '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
multi_order_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as multi_order_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
  WHERE order_count > 1
),
total_jan_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * m.multi_order_count / t.total_count, 2) as share_pct
FROM multi_order_customers m
CROSS JOIN total_jan_customers t;

WITH valid_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    AND is_internal = FALSE
),
valid_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    AND status != 'cancelled'
    AND placed_at >= '2025-02-01'
    AND placed_at < '2025-03-01'
),
customers_with_order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    vc.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT vo.customer_id) > 0 AS has_order,
    COUNT(DISTINCT vo.customer_id) AS order_count
  FROM valid_customers vc
  LEFT JOIN valid_orders vo ON vc.customer_id = vo.customer_id
  GROUP BY vc.customer_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS pct_customers_with_multiple_orders
FROM customers_with_order_counts;
